notes: Obsidian plugin. Each registered LangChain provider class binds its chat-model class in load() (`this.llmClass = X`), and the model is built by one polymorphic construction, `new (this.llmClass as typeof ChatOpenAI)(llmConfig)` at src/LLMProviders/langchain/base.tsx:123. That one line builds 15 different chat models with different outcomes, so there is one site per registered provider, recorded at the provider's `this.llmClass = ...` line (the bound class reference). `call_line` gives the shared construction line. The same applies to the Custom raw-HTTP providers: the single fetch is at src/LLMProviders/custom/base.tsx:127. Default (Custom) is recorded there, because the base class is itself 'Default (Custom)'. Anthropic Legacy (Custom) is recorded at its endpoint override (anthropic.tsx:30). API keys, base paths and models come from the plugin's own settings (LLMProviderOptions / settings.api_key), i.e. app config that the operator (the Obsidian user) sets, not per-request or per-tenant objects. Models are picked at runtime from settings, and default_values only seeds them. Not counted, because they are not generation endpoints: the raw-HTTP model-list GETs at src/LLMProviders/utils.tsx:99 (`${basePath}/models`), src/LLMProviders/langchain/chatanthropic.tsx:174 (`${basePath}/v1/models`) and src/LLMProviders/langchain/googleGenerativeAI.tsx:136 (generativelanguage /v1beta/models). Also not counted: LangSmith hub prompt pulls in src/lib/langchain-hub-pull.ts, and base.tsx:74 (`this.llmClass = ChatOpenAI` in the unregistered base LangchainProvider, which every subclass overrides).

sites.why: Rule 8: ChatOpenAI on chat-completions. baseURL comes from the provider's Base Path setting, which defaults to https://api.openai.com/v1. Key comes from plugin settings. Model is picked at runtime from settings (default gpt-4o is a catalog id). This is the default selectedProvider.

Rule 8: ChatOpenAI (reasoning_effort via modelKwargs) with Base Path setting defaulting to api.openai.com/v1 and key from settings. Model is picked at runtime from settings. The seeded default o1-mini is NOT in the catalog, but the repo's OpenAI model list has catalog ids (o1, o3, o3-mini, o4-mini, gpt-4o, ...), so rule 6 does not apply.

Rule 8: ChatAnthropic on Messages. anthropicApiUrl comes from the Base Path setting (default https://api.anthropic.com/). Key comes from settings. Model is picked at runtime: the seeded default claude-3-5-sonnet-latest is not in the catalog, but the repo's Anthropic list has claude-sonnet-4-6 and claude-opus-4-6. Extended thinking is GA (not a beta). The only extra header is anthropic-dangerous-direct-browser-access, which is not anthropic-beta.

Rule 2: the generic 'Custom' provider fetches a Handlebars-templated endpoint/header/body that the user defines in provider settings (it is meant for arbitrary OpenAI-compatible servers). The placeholder default is https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions with model gpt-3.5-turbo-16k (not in the catalog). This same fetch also serves Anthropic Legacy (Custom) (next site).

Rule 7: raw HTTP POST to https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages (endpoint setting defaults to it; header/body templates are locked to the Anthropic format, x-api-key from settings). Model is runtime/settings: the seeded claude-2.1 is not in the catalog, but the repo's Anthropic list has catalog ids, so rule 6 does not apply.
